name: Windmill
description: Windmill is an open-source developer platform that turns scripts into webhooks, workflows and UIs. Scripts in Python, TypeScript, Bash, SQL and more get an auto-generated form and API, and can be chained into flows, run on schedules or triggers, and back low-code apps.

notes.text: Log in with the default credentials right away: Windmill then asks for a new superadmin account. Until then, anyone who reaches port 8000 can log in.
Webhook URLs and OAuth redirects are built from BASE_URL in /opt/windmill_data/.env. Update it after an IP change or behind a reverse proxy or domain, then restart windmill.
Python, TypeScript on Bun, Bash, DuckDB and SQL work out of the box. Other languages need their runtime installed in the container first.
